title: Retry a failed feed fetch before giving up on the run
description:
The supplier's CDN drops a connection a few times a day, and each one has been costing us a whole five-minute cycle plus a page to the on-call. This retries the fetch, twice by default (`FEED_RETRIES`), with a short backoff, and only fails the run once every attempt has failed.

The fetch now takes its `request` function as a dependency so the retry can be tested without a server. Bumped to 1.5.0 since the retry changes what a transient outage looks like in the logs, and raised the Node floor to 20, which is what every depot runs now and what `undici`'s current release needs.

commit.subject: Retry a failed feed fetch before giving up on the run
commit.body:
Two retries by default, FEED_RETRIES to change it. The fetch takes its
request function as a dependency so the retry is testable. 1.5.0, Node 20.
